name: si_unit_symbols
description: Produce case-sensitive SI unit symbols from spelled-out measurement units, without numerical conversion; controls copy the measurement value.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
units={'meter':'m','second':'s','ampere':'A','kelvin':'K','mole':'mol','candela':'cd','hertz':'Hz','newton':'N','pascal':'Pa','joule':'J','watt':'W','coulomb':'C','volt':'V','farad':'F','ohm':'Ω','siemens':'S','weber':'Wb','tesla':'T','henry':'H','becquerel':'Bq','gray':'Gy','sievert':'Sv','katal':'kat'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(115):
 u=list(units)[i%len(units)];n=random.randrange(2,200)
 items.append({'prompt':f'Measurement: {n} {u}. Write only the standard SI unit symbol, preserving its correct case.\nSymbol:', 'answer':' '+units[u]})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Measurement: {n} {u}. Write only the numerical value exactly as given.\nValue:', 'answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
